scope: One bounded complete-passage repairs after specific observed failure/defect; preserve all originals and good recordings.

segments.spokenText: Use a hypothetical first-order model with an initial concentration of eight milligrams per kilogram. If the half-life is ten days under those model conditions, four remains after ten days and two after twenty. Each interval halves the remaining amount; it does not subtract four indefinitely. The equation is eight times one-half raised to the number of half-life intervals. In rate-constant form, half-life equals the natural logarithm of two divided by the rate constant. The model must fit the data and conditions.
segments.delivery:
Speak natural clear conversational English for university students. Warm, steady, medium-paced explanation with natural pauses, not an advertisement or news announcer. Speak the transcript only as one coherent passage; preserve all scientific meaning. Stable light warm female mid-register voice.
Maintain the light, clear conversational Kore register of the approved English sample. Avoid a lowered, heavy or metallic announcer sound. Keep natural full sentences and every quantity exactly.
segments.listeningMethod: Explicitly owner-approved English Pro proof delivery; actual new recording requires review.
segments.repairReason: Two actual-audio comparisons found a materially heavier and lower-register Kore voice than the owner-approved reference; first targeted delivery correction after the successful second generation attempt.
